data.acquisitionSummary: 2degrees currently offers new Prepay customers a physical SIM or eSIM with free delivery and adds the NZ$8 Monthly Plan to the new SIM. Current official Prepay guidance requires a minimum NZ$10 top-up every 365 days to keep the account active.

keep.action: Top up at least NZ$10 every 365 days to keep the Prepay account active. Current official guidance says unused balance is forfeited and the SIM expires if this is not done.

data.chinaActivation: Current official material supports online eSIM/SIM ordering and eSIM QR installation, but the reviewed sources do not establish that a brand-new Prepay line can complete first activation from overseas. Roaming requires an active Prepay plan, so do not rely on overseas-first activation without a fresh explicit provider statement.
data.kyc: The reviewed ordinary 2degrees Prepay activation/help flow does not state an identity-document verification step. This is provider-flow evidence only, not a blanket legal claim about New Zealand prepaid registration.
data.payment: Prepay top-up is supported in the 2degrees app and online; current minimum top-up is NZ$10. Card/Online EFTPOS/voucher methods are documented, with issuer/country acceptance to be checked at payment time.
data.wifiCalling: Not relied on for this route decision.
data.roamingSms: 2degrees documents Prepay roaming and text use abroad. Its current Daily Roaming trigger list names sending a text but does not name receiving a text as a trigger; exact inbound-SMS charging and service-specific OTP reliability should not be overstated.
data.holdReason: The stale retention-terms blocker is resolved, but overseas-first activation of a brand-new Prepay line is not established by the reviewed current official material. Keep as HOLD for the typical overseas-only acquisition use case.
data.tariffSummary: New SIM/eSIM currently starts with the NZ$8 Monthly Plan; minimum NZ$10 top-up every 365 days keeps Prepay active. Overseas-first activation remains unverified.
guideSteps: Order a new physical SIM or eSIM with the current Prepay entry plan.
Do not assume a brand-new line can first-activate abroad; establish activation before relying on roaming.
Top up at least NZ$10 every 365 days to prevent account/SIM expiry.
